title: British couple released after detention in Afghanistan say they feared being executed
summary: Barbie Reynolds, 76, and husband Peter, 80, said it was never explained to them why they were imprisoned A British couple who were reunited with their family in the UK after being released from almost eight months in detention in Afghanistan, said they feared being executed by the Taliban. Peter Reynolds, 80, and his wife Barbie, 76, who arrived at Heathrow on Saturday , said it was never explained to them why they were imprisoned in Afghanistan since their arrest in February.
